name: slides
description: slides — terminal-based presentation tool. Create and present markdown slideshows in the terminal. Non-interactive rendering.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/maaslalani/slides/releases/download/v0.9.0/slides_0.9.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf slides_0.9.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv slides /usr/local/bin/ && rm slides_0.9.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz

commands.description: slides — terminal-based presentation tool. Create and present markdown slideshows in the terminal. Non-interactive rendering.
